## What we use

The LoRa modem parameters (SF and BW sets, demodulator SNR per SF, LDRO rule),
receive sensitivities and tolerances, transmit power and current, synthesiser
phase noise (SPEC-003 rev 2), the product-page figures, and the absence of any
Semtech LoRa part above 2.5 GHz (C10). Restated in SPEC-003 and
`vendor/summary/semtech.md`. No figure, table or text is reproduced.
